title: DS-160: Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application
before: Choose the embassy or consulate where you'll be interviewed, then write down your Application ID and security answer: you need them to return to a saved form.
The DS-160 times out after 20 minutes without activity. Press Save on each page.
You'll upload a digital photo (600x600 to 1200x1200 pixels, white background, taken in the last 6 months).

sections.title: Personal Information 1
yourself: Full name in your native alphabet

sections.title: Personal Information 2

fields.label: National identification number
fields.note: Only if your passport shows one. Otherwise tick Does Not Apply.

yourself: Other nationalities and permanent residence elsewhere
U.S. Social Security and taxpayer numbers (usually Does Not Apply)

fields.label: Purpose of trip
fields.note: Tourism and visiting family or friends are B (Temp. Business or Pleasure Visitor), then B1/B2.

fields.label: Address where you will stay in the U.S.

sections.title: Travel Companions

fields.label: Are other persons traveling with you?

yourself: Companions' names and relationship, if any

sections.title: Previous U.S. Travel

fields.label: Have you ever been in the U.S.?
Have you ever been issued a U.S. visa?
Have you ever been refused a U.S. visa?

yourself: Dates and length of earlier visits, and earlier visa numbers

sections.title: Address and Phone
yourself: Social media identifiers for the last five years (required)
Phone numbers and emails used in the last five years

sections.title: Passport

fields.label: Have you ever lost a passport?

yourself: City where the passport was issued
Passport book number (usually Does Not Apply)

fields.label: Contact person or organization in the U.S.
fields.note: A hotel is acceptable if you don't know anyone.

sections.title: Family
yourself: Father's and mother's names and dates of birth
Spouse's name, date and place of birth, if married

sections.title: Work / Education / Training

fields.label: Present employer or school name and address

yourself: Monthly salary in local currency and a short description of your duties
Previous employers and education (secondary school and above)

sections.title: Security and Background
yourself: Five pages of yes/no questions on health, criminal history, security and immigration. Answer each one truthfully yourself.

after: Upload your photo, review every page and sign electronically with your passport number. Print the confirmation page with its barcode.
Pay the $185 machine-readable visa (MRV) fee and book your interview through your country's U.S. visa appointment service.
Bring the DS-160 confirmation, appointment letter, fee receipt, passport and the documents on your checklist to the interview.
Record your interview result on your dashboard.
